title: Temporal Correctness: Visual Guide
outline: 1. The As-Of Join | two loan applications joined to a customer income dimension by entity id alone and by an effective-interval as-of condition | joining on the key alone gives historical examples the current value, so a March application trains against July's income with no error and no NULL

2. Two Clocks Again | five clinical facts with separate event times and availability times, filtered by a draggable prediction hour | a prediction cannot use a fact that had not arrived yet, so the serving boundary is availability time and both timestamps must be stored

3. Leakage Audit | seven candidate features classified clean or leaking, including a window anchored to the build date and an out-of-fold target encoding, plus four detection checks | the counterfactual test is whether production could obtain this exact value at this freshness before predicting, and leakage can enter through columns, windows, preprocessing or sampling

4. Splitting Honestly | thirty-six rows over six repeating customers split randomly, temporally and by group, with entity overlap and time overlap counted | a random split leaks through repeated entities and future rows, while temporal splits answer the drift question and group splits answer the memorization question

5. Same Number, Different Truth | five kinds of training-serving skew with the offline and online sides shown, labelled by whether shared code fixes them | shared code fixes duplicated definitions and nothing else, because schedules, freshness, defaults and versions all diverge underneath identical transformation logic
